q: Do you think it's important to do volunteer work?
a: Definitely. We can give back to society by doing volunteer work. It's also a good way to socialise and make new friends.
vocab: help to raise funding for charity
社交并且结识新的朋友

q: How do you feel when you see people dropping litter?
a: Their behaviour makes me feel upset. They're selfish and don't care about the environment. Sometimes I pick up others' litter, but I don't always have the time to do that.

q: What are some common types of noise in your city?
a: The most common types of noise in my city are traffic noise, including honking, and construction noise. Loud music is also very common in my city.

q: How do you feel when you're in a crowded place?
a:
I'm quite sociable, so I tend to feel comfortable when I'm in a crowded place.

或者：
I tend to feel a bit nervous when I'm in a crowded place, especially when the place is crowded with people I don't know.

q: What are important qualities for friends to have?
a: I suppose the most important quality for friends to have is honesty because we can't trust people who tell lies. A good sense of humour is also an important quality for friends to have.
vocab: 诚实（相关：a sense of responsibility 责任感）

q: How do you usually keep in touch with friends who live far away?
a: I often chat with them on social media. Sometimes I also share photos and videos with them.

q: Do you usually spend your birthday with your family or with your friends?
a:
I usually spend my birthday with my friends because my family live in another city. My friends usually throw a birthday party for me, which is nice and thoughtful.

或者：
I tend to spend my birthday with my family. We usually have my birthday dinner in a nice restaurant, and then go to the cinema.
vocab: 开生日派对（throw a party 和 have a party 都是"开派对"的意思）

q: Do you like to spend time alone?
a: I'm quite sociable and I have many friends. But I try to spend at least a few minutes every day alone, so I can concentrate on my own tasks and avoid distractions.
Yes, my friends often visit me at home. I enjoy catching up with them and cooking for them.
vocab: 跟朋友们"聊近况"，不是指追上朋友

q: What are the qualities that good teachers have?
a: Good teachers know their subject well and enjoy sharing their knowledge with their students. They are also very patient and have a good sense of humour.
vocab: 很了解他们所教的科目
enjoy sharing their knowledge with their students
享受和他们的学生们分享知识
have a good sense of humour
encourage their students to think independently
鼓励学生们独立地思考

q: Do you think it's better for students to have teachers or to teach themselves?
a: In my opinion, students can learn more efficiently with teachers' guidance. At the same time, teachers should encourage their students to think independently.
vocab: encourage their students to think independently
鼓励他们的学生们独立思考

q: What do you think is the best thing about being a teenager?
a: The best thing about being a teenager is probably the opportunity to explore new things. They are encouraged to explore things that they are not familiar with and learn through mistakes.
vocab: the opportunity to explore new things

q: Would you like to be a celebrity?
a:
Yes, I'd like to because being a celebrity would give me a strong sense of achievement. And I would be able to socialise and make friends with many other celebrities, which would be fun and exciting.

或者：
No. Being a celebrity would mean losing my privacy and having paparazzi following me around. I don't think I would enjoy this kind of lifestyle.
vocab: 有狗仔队到处跟着我（paparazzi 是集合名词，不能加 s）
